run_write_html_wrappers: run write_html_wrappers to generate download.html files for each wheel in inside/output directories
run_to_aws: run to_aws to upload all wheel files from inside/output to s3://dl.fbaipublicfiles.com/vissl/packaging/apexwheels/
run_fs3cmd: run fs3cmd to invoke the fairusers_aws fs3cmd binary with put, get, or other s3 operations
review_write_html_wrappers: review write_html_wrappers which creates HTML download links for .whl files per output directory
review_to_aws: review to_aws which iterates inside/output directories and uploads files to an S3 bucket via fs3cmd
